notes.title: Add your social media profiles
notes.text: Social media profiles are now a list of links. Tap + to add one, and a link to Facebook, X, LinkedIn or Pinterest gets its name and icon on its own.

notes.title: Pick up where you left off
notes.text: Your last 3 pages and blog posts now wait at the top of the start screen. Tap one to jump straight back in.

notes.title: Read notifications without leaving your page
notes.text: The bell in the top bar now opens your notifications beside the screen you’re on. On a phone, press and hold a notification to select it and delete it.
Old editor links and bookmarks still open, and the standard parts now have English names
The filters and sorts you saved in the editor reset once
The header’s call to action can show your phone number as a text button before its button
Theme store is now its own screen, first under Appearance
Header and Footer now come right after Themes under Appearance, and Business has its own section with Logo and icon
On a phone, swiping back from a section’s list takes you to the main menu
Notifications also tell you when your website updated Morpheme, undid an update or got stuck
Open website opens in a new window
On a phone, the text toolbar no longer scrolls sideways
